android.desc:
Log your business mileage quickly and easily with Trtl.

- Data stored on your device
- Data is easily exported for backup and filing taxes
- Records date, distance and destination
- No finicky gps

This is a redux of an older app that I created to help me with my own small business. The terminal flair was added as a fun visual challenge.

quotes.text:
I wrote an app to log mileage while doing deliveries, etc for my small business. It gives me a small tax benefit at the end of the year. To make it more fun, I gave the UI a "terminal" flair.

I wrote it over the course of a week or so and I use it frequently.

It's not that it won't see the light of day for anyone else but it's a very specific niche so I doubt anyone would even find it on the app store

If anyone's curious: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.thisischris.terminal.triplogger
